column1: If it is literally becoming one line when pasted, don't use the chat copy button. Instead:
Paste into Notepad (or a plain text editor) first.
Then copy from Notepad into Overleaf.
Here's the shortest working version, with each statement on its own line:
If even this appears on one line, the problem is not the LaTeX code. It's that whatever you're using to paste is stripping newlines. In that case, tell me:
Are you pasting into Overleaf source mode or Visual Editor?
Or are you pasting into a code block inside your assignment?
Since I can see you have the Overleaf project open, make sure you're in the Source Editor (the .tex file), not the Visual Editor.
